title: Quick-Fried Venezuelan Cheese Bake
description: A rapid and indulgent Venezuelan-inspired dish featuring melted cheese, crispy coconut flakes, and a satisfying umami flavor.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, a pinch of salt, and a grind of black pepper.
Add the milk to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Stir in the queso fresco until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 8-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the coconut flakes over the top of the cheese mixture.
Drizzle the olive oil over the coconut flakes.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
